title: Expedition quest and event ticks
kicker: Idle expeditions · quests and world events
hook: **Vision:** idle expedition ticks that open **quests** and **world events** — a story clock, not only loot. Not finished / not playable yet as that handoff.

blindSpots.meaning: Locked design. Full quest and world-event handoff from expedition ticks is not something you can rely on in the current loop.
A beat while an expedition is out — quiet stretches, finds, meetings, injuries today; quest/event starts later.
A tick that opens a tracked quest (or world event), not only a material line in the return report.
The world pushing narrative beats — opposite of a pure loot clock.

alsoTrue: Dispatch → wait → collect already ships. Thin in-run expedition event flavour can appear without this Vision handoff.
Discoveries that open domains for the Delve hang on the same Vision story.

sections.title: Not finished / not playable yet
paras: Do not expect every expedition return to open a quest log entry or a world raid.
Read this page for the intended story clock — play loot and roster outcomes on [expeditions](expeditions) today.

sections.title: What it is (design)
paras: While a squad is out, ticks can do more than pay materials.
Vision: some ticks start quests, surface world events, or discover doors into domains for the Delve.

groups.title: When it ships
groups.intro: The fantasy hangs on Expeditions plus the quest layer.
steps: When a tick opens a quest or event, it would surface in the [quest log](quest-log) / [world events](world-events) surfaces.
Until then, treat missing quest prompts as Vision — not a broken expedition.
groups.note: Full handoff is Vision even if thin expedition event ticks exist in reports.

doTitle: What you do with this page
doSteps: Keep using dispatch → wait → collect for loot, XP, and wild joins.
Do not wait on expedition returns for a finished quest log.
When you want the story-clock fantasy, read [quest log](quest-log) and [world events](world-events) as Vision siblings.
doNote: Stop when Vision ticks ≠ live payouts. Shipped loop: [expeditions](expeditions).

mixUps.q: Why didn’t my overnight run open a quest?
mixUps.a: Quest and world-event ticks are Vision. Absence is expected.

mixUps.q: Are quiet stretches and injuries Vision too?
mixUps.a: No. Those in-run tick flavours belong to the shipped expedition chain; the quest/event handoff is the Vision piece.
No. Expeditions stay idle forever. Ticks add story, they do not delete the loop.

mixUps.q: Is this the same as the quest log?
mixUps.a: Related. Ticks would feed the log; the log itself is Vision — see [quest log](quest-log).
